description: Silva de Souza, Carlos Eduardo and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The public deliverable contains simulated turbine time series from a SATH 10 MW floating offshore model. SIMA couples SIMO rigid-body dynamics with RIFLEX finite-element representations, with BEM aerodynamics and dynamic wakes. Operational and idling cases use wind, waves and current associated with Buchan Deep, including selected mooring-line failures. Only the public turbine signals are included; the deposit does not establish access to every mooring or internal model result. These outputs support floating-turbine response assessment under the stated load cases. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
